title: Make remux fallback override-safe
summary: Changes SizeGuardMode fallback_remux so forced route overrides warn only while automatic size/bitrate threshold encodes can fallback to safe remux after oversized encode output.
reason: The operator treats forced route overrides as hard intent and wants no automatic route switching for them. Automatic threshold-driven encodes that grow out of scope should not publish the oversized encode when a safe remux fallback is available.
behavior_before: fallback_remux attempted remux for oversized folder-policy force-encode outputs and did not request remux for automatic size/bitrate threshold encodes.
behavior_after: fallback_remux does not request remux for forced route overrides. Oversized automatic size/bitrate threshold encodes request safe remux fallback before encode publish, and successful fallback remux carries warning/review evidence.
manual_validation: python unittest targeted verification/decision/settings/WebView suite - passed
rollback_plan: Restore fallback_remux eligibility to the previous forced-encode-only behavior, restore operator help text, refresh summaries, then rerun focused PowerShell route-selection and Python/WebView settings tests. Because this changes media-policy behavior, rerun representative real-media encode/remux validation after rollback if this path was exercised.
high_risk_notes: Touches post-encode route fallback and publish acceptance evidence. Validation must include focused PowerShell unit coverage and should be followed by representative real-media validation for automatic size/bitrate fallback success and fallback-blocked failure.
notes:
Keep source mutation forbidden. Preserve remux-safe codec/container checks for fallback; do not alter FFmpeg command generation.
